items.title: 68090_Ed Garland oral history interview
items.q: -- and Blakely played the trumpet. I come along with the tambourine... they'd throw money in the tambourine.

ctx.x: I come along with the tambourine, pap-pap-pap-pap- and walk up and holding on it -- they'd throw money in the tambourine. I'd -- I'd say, don't forget that's my 50 cents, you give me my 50 cents. -- say what're you doing there. Hey cut that out, don't forget my 50 cents.
